methodology.confidence_interval: For all use original judge summary CI95; for split use 5000 percentile bootstrap resamples (seed 2026).
methodology.rates: Risk-level weighted case rate with threshold.
methodology.latency: Unweighted mean generation latency per turn from predictions.jsonl (GPU/device-dependent).
methodology.comparison: Paired bootstrap difference weighted by risk_level, Wilcoxon p unweighted.
methodology.caveat: Includes data-driven model judge ratings, not clinician-validated medical safety.
